# DAX logical functions in Lumen

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

Support status, in Lumen's DAX engine, of every function that Microsoft's DAX reference lists under **Logical functions**: 15 implemented, 0 partial and 0 not implemented, out of 15.

| Function | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| AND | Implemented |  |
| BITAND | Implemented |  |
| BITLSHIFT | Implemented |  |
| BITOR | Implemented |  |
| BITRSHIFT | Implemented |  |
| BITXOR | Implemented |  |
| COALESCE | Implemented |  |
| FALSE | Implemented |  |
| IF | Implemented |  |
| IF.EAGER | Implemented |  |
| IFERROR | Implemented |  |
| NOT | Implemented |  |
| OR | Implemented |  |
| SWITCH | Implemented |  |
| TRUE | Implemented |  |
